$Comment: How much more a critical Fire hit deals, in whole percent points of the hit, added to CritDamage in ziggfreed-common's crit step on a hit whose damage cause is Fire or inherits from it. Any item's StatModifiers, an effect's RawStatModifiers or a pick's grant raise it like any stat. Base 0 (CritDamage carries the base half again); Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps.
